gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed brain glioblastomas located in a surgically accessible brain region for resection

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] 5-Aminolevulinic Acid: SDT treatment with 5-ALA using the ExAblate Model 4000 Type-2 "Neuro-System".
Secondary objective of the trial is to assess the efficacy of the SDT procedure in terms of tumor regression and/or cell apoptosis and necrosis.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in patients with newly diagnosed cerebral glioblastomas using the ExAblate Model 4000 Type-2 "Neuro-System".

role_evidence.quote: The idea of the present study is to investigate the antitumor effects of SDT in patients affected by HGGs attained with low-frequency Focused Ultrasound.

agents.drug_class_hint: porphyrin precursor / sonosensitiser (PpIX precursor) used for sonodynamic therapy with MRI-guided focused ultrasound
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: 5-ALA is a PpIX precursor that accumulates selectively in tumour; low-intensity focused ultrasound activates it, causing cytotoxic events limited to the target tissue (sonodynamic effect)

coder_notes: 5-ALA sonodynamic therapy with ExAblate focused ultrasound: candidate with device_dependent true (C12). Histology after resection for apoptosis and necrosis is planned as an efficacy outcome; coded as treatment response rather than target engagement (target_engagement_planned = no), adjudicator may consider otherwise. Detailed description refers to HGG but conditions/eligibility restrict to glioblastoma.
